name: Funnel
description: Conversion funnel from the measures on the Stages shelf (e.g. Started → Submitted → Approved → Disbursed): one box per stage with % of start and % of previous stage, the drop between stages, overall conversion and the weakest step.

encodings.name: Stages
encodings.tooltip: One measure per stage, in funnel order (e.g. COUNTD(Started), COUNTD(Submitted), COUNTD(Approved), COUNTD(Disbursed)). Drag to reorder; rename and recolor in Format Extension.
